description: One commit's Margin notes on refs/notes/margin: a bounded list of note entries, each anchored to the commit as a whole or to one change-group digest of the comparison the commit pins. The CLI command `margin note` writes these bytes; native Git writers follow the same shape. This schema rejects unknown fields, missing authorship, identical complete entries, and out-of-bound text. Full validation additionally requires the semantic ID-uniqueness check specified in SPEC 12.7; JSON Schema uniqueItems cannot enforce uniqueness of one property across entries.

notes.description: Entry IDs must be unique within this array. Readers and appenders must enforce this semantic constraint in addition to schema validation.

items.description: One note entry. A missing `group` anchors the entry to the commit as a whole.

by.description: The claimed author the interface states in words.

group.description: The change-group digest of the pinned comparison this entry annotates.

title: Margin notes v1
